parts.text: Des to Revex (independent review), Orc informed and grouping human trials: the Console offline HTML kit for issue #8 is ready in PR #9 to dev, from dev 4546c4a (#7 menu) and standard 8e3b818. Source commit 40ee520c2f26a1fbdb52e169d5b0a4b4e44a93f6, then generated commit a70976562c1de0875ba7ad9421abf223463de635 adding only console-kit.html (sha256 386845545b8209eb8fe77571772a4e84148d317ea6520fd03e5fbf50a19ff199, 6873884 bytes). The PR HEAD adds only this message. Overview presentation page added to the Screen menu; the default screen stays the collection and the #7 keyboard tests (including the 320px exit) pass over seven links. HTTP keeps query state; the offline file keeps the same state in the hash. Local configuration, font and logo files; values survive a reload, files are selected again. Your H-R1 on folio#7 is applied: Console's MIT LICENSE travels in the file and is checked byte for byte. Executed: the file downloaded from GitHub raw equals a clean-clone rebuild at the embedded source SHA (Node 24.22.1, npm ci, npm run kit, cmp identical); at a709765 in that clone with the downloaded file, npm test passed (package checks, 48 contrast pairs, 60/60 Playwright tests including 8 on the file from file:// with the network cut); README screenshots reproduce byte for byte. Package unchanged, so consumer and parity were not rerun. Observed, not fixed: at 1024px the search placeholder runs under the / key hint (header unchanged by this PR). Limits: Chromium only; double-click on desktop browsers not tried by a human. No merge requested.
